DESCRIPTION: Tanshindiol C is a S-adenosylmethionine-competitive EZH2 ( Histone Methyltransferase ) inhibitor with an IC 50 of 0.55 Î¼M for inhibiting the methyltransferase activity. Tanshindiol C is also an activator of both Nrf2 and Sirtuin 1 (Sirt1) in macrophages. Tanshindiol C possesses anti-cancer activity, and can be used for atherosclerosis researchIn VitroTanshindiol C (1-10 Î¼M; for 24 h) activates Nrf2 and upregulates Prdx1 expression and mRNA levels in macrophages. Tanshindiol C protects macrophages from oxidized low-density lipoprotein (oxLDL) induced foam cell formation via activation of Prdx1/ABCA1 signaling. Tanshindiol C inhibits both wild-type and A667G mutant (K i value of 176 nM) EZH2 activity with similar potencies. Tanshindiol C inhibits growth of the cell lines such as Pfeiffer, U-2932 and Daudi (lymphoma), PC3 (prostate cancer), T98G and U87MG (glioma), and A549 (lung cancer), with GI 50 values of 1.5 Î¼M, 9.5 Î¼M, 10.6 Î¼M, 4 Î¼M, 6 Î¼M, 5.7 Î¼M and 4.2 Î¼M, respectively. PRODUCT_NAME: Memmert® ICO240K7 CO2 Incubator w/ Active Humidity Control 241L | 8.4 cu. ft.
DESCRIPTION:
The Memmert ICO240 K7 CO2 Incubator w/ Active Humidity Control 241L, 115V offers unparalleled precision and control for demanding laboratory applications, ensuring optimal protection for cell cultures, bacteria cultures, and tissue cultures. Designed with user-friendliness in mind, it features an intuitive operating system complemented by a high-quality stainless steel inner chamber and housing that are both corrosion-resistant and easy to clean. This incubator excels in maintaining a hygienic environment with its rounded interior edges and the ability to sterilize the interior at 180°C for 60 minutes without removing sensors, promoting effortless cleaning and maintenance.

Equipped with an advanced control system, the ICO240 K7 reaches desired temperatures swiftly without overshoots, and it includes a battery-buffered ControlCOCKPIT for continuous CO2 control, even during power outages. Alarm notifications can be sent directly to your mobile device, ensuring the safety and integrity of the chamber's contents. The incubator comes with an integrated data logger and a digital timer that can be set from 1 minute to 99 days and 23 hours, supporting complex ramping processes and precise temperature control. With the K7 active humidity option installed, this CO2 Incubator allows for direct humidity control from 40 to 97% RH, or no RH.

Further enhancing its functionality, the ICO240 K7 features the AtmoCONTROL software for easy programming and online monitoring of up to 32 connected devices. The software enables simple drag-and-drop input of values and can send automatic alarm messages to multiple email addresses. The SetpointWAIT function ensures that process times start only when the target temperature is reached at all monitoring points. With its robust construction and high-end safety features, the Memmert ICO240 K7 CO2 Incubator is an indispensable tool for any research facility focused on cell and tissue culture.

DESCRIPTION:
Somatostatin acts at many sites to inhibit the release of many hormones and other secretory proteins. The biologic effects of somatostatin are probably mediated by a family of G protein-coupled receptors that are expressed in a tissue-specific manner. SST1 receptor is a Gi/Go-coupled GPCR which is expressed in pancreatic islets, pituitary, Cerebellum (Purkinje cells), frontal cortex (pyramidal cells), hippocampus (CA1-4 subfields and some granule cells of the dentate gyrus). It inhibits cAMP accumulation and stimulates tyrosine phosphatase activity, it also can antiproliferation.
GenScript's SST1-expressing stable cell line was made in CHO-K1/Gqi5 host cell and optimized for calcium assays.

DESCRIPTION:
The ChemiSCREEN™ β2 Adrenoceptor Receptor Stable Cell Line is an engineered cell line for use in studying drug candidates (small molecules or biologics) targeting GPCRs. This cell line enables assessment of ligand (e.g. epinephrine and norepinephrine) based activation of ADRB2 GPCR activity via detection of increasing levels of intracellular calcium. The included cell line overexpresses ADRB2 alongside endogenous high levels of the promiscuous G protein, Gα15, coupling the receptor to the calcium signaling pathway. Upon activation of ADRB2 , the resulting calcium activity can be fluorescently assayed.

This stable engineered cell line is provided as two vials of cryopreserved cells.
